android.notes:
Measure and log an angle. With the angle tool's shape selected, the timing lane offers a fourth button that appends the measurement and its timecode to the clip's notes, so a session leaves a readable trail.

Share a clip straight out. The + menu's Share row sends the loop region with your drawings burned in to the phone's own share sheet, with no save dialog on the way.

Manage what the app is holding. The cold-open screen now shows what is on the device and offers Free Space to clear it out by age or by kind, plus an optional Auto-clean rule for raw videos. Auto-clean is off unless you turn it on, and every dialog says exactly what it will remove.

The landscape top bar works again. Its buttons sit at the very top of the frame, and taps on them land - the status bar used to sit over that strip and swallow them.

Support InForm. The app is donation-based, and there is now one place that says so and how.

Finding a YouTube video is YouTube's job now: share a link from the YouTube app and InForm opens it.
